area.evidence: 5-foot-radius Emanation. Radius by Cultivation Level: 1-4: 5 feet; 5-10: 10 feet; 11-16: 15 feet; 17-20: 20 feet.

effects.evidence: You emit a field of unstable Qi.
The first time on a turn that a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP or casts a spell using a spell slot, it makes a Constitution saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: Failed Save: The technique is Turbulent until it resolves; the creature stays marked Turbulent until the end of your next turn.

riders: The Emanation is centered on you and moves with you; it does not affect you (combat/ext/qi_instability.py). Its radius is 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 feet at Cultivation Level 1-4 / 5-10 / 11-16 / 17-20.

The first time on a turn a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP (Qi, Stamina or Resonance), it makes a Constitution save against your technique save DC. A failure marks it Turbulent until the end of your next turn: the technique suffers one complication the GM picks (visible backlash, noisy activation, reduced range, accidental self-exposure, or minor damage to an unattended nearby object) and is not wasted (the log names it). Casting a spell with a spell slot: this engine has no spell slots.
If the campaign uses wild magic or Qi-deviation rules, the instability chance of creatures inside the area rises by 50 percent (not used: no such system here; the fallback above is).

Talent Type: Movement and Protection.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature within Thread range falls, is pushed, is pulled, or is knocked Prone.
